name: search_entities
description: Search PermID for organizations, people, instruments, or quotes by name. Returns PermID, primary type, name, and a brief context. Use get_entity with the PermID for the full linked-data record.

name: get_entity
description: Fetch the raw JSON-LD PermID record for a numeric PermID (e.g. "4295905573"). Returns the full linked-data payload from api-eit.refinitiv.com under the key "raw" — extract organization name, LEI, RIC, industry codes, and headquarters from the raw fields.
